correction_note: v1 was unblinded with a simulator that applied one common dust rotation to all bands (frequency-dependent misalignment could not mimic a calibration difference), with posterior samples outside the uniform prior support, and unseeded sampling. v2 fixes the simulator (per-map rotation), rejects out-of-support samples, seeds sampling, retrains and revalidates. The exact rotation makes beta exactly degenerate with psi, so the primary statistics are beta - psi0 and beta under stated psi0 priors, with validated interval calibration. v1 results are preserved in results/npe_unblind_v1.json.
report: primary: beta - psi0 and beta given psi0 ~ N(0, 0.5/1/2 deg) (median, 68/95%, widened by the validated interval scale max(1, k)); beta alone is reported but prior-limited (exact beta-psi degeneracy); ensemble of 5 MAFs
